name: Pallof Press
summary: An anti-rotation press that trains the abs and obliques to resist twisting. Works with a cable machine or a resistance band.
setup: Set a cable or band at chest height and stand sideways to the anchor.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step away until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
execution: Brace the abs and press the handle straight out in front of the chest.
Hold briefly with the arms extended while resisting the pull.
Bring the handle back to the chest under control.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.
cues: Do not let the torso twist
mistakes: Rotating toward the anchor: lighten the load and keep the shoulders square.
Leaning away: stand tall and keep the ribs down.
Rushing the reps: slow the tempo.
Standing too close to the anchor: step away until the pull is challenging.
